qa_pairs.instruction: Summarize what is covered in Part I of the Fan-Out driver documentation.
qa_pairs.output: Part I of the Fan-Out driver documentation provides an overview of the concepts and facilities of the NetIQ Identity Manager Fan-Out driver. It is organized into three chapters: Section 1.0 – Introduction, Section 2.0 – Structure and Function, and Section 3.0 – Examples.

qa_pairs.instruction: What topics are included in the Concepts and Facilities section of the Fan-Out driver documentation?
qa_pairs.output: The Concepts and Facilities section of the Fan-Out driver documentation includes three topics: an Introduction (Section 1.0), a discussion of the driver’s Structure and Function (Section 2.0), and a set of Examples (Section 3.0) that illustrate how the Fan-Out driver works.
